_readme: Picture for each strap a shopper can pick. Keys are the EXACT Ecwid option
value, so you look a strap up with no renaming, slugifying or guessing.
Verified 2026-10-07 against the live Strap option on US 55001151 and Canada
793363376 (Original Custom Grass Sticks), and Pick Your Design on US 116311087
(MTN Straps). Full URL = base + the filename.
US sells 14 designs. Canada sells the same 14 plus Salida Magic, so the list
below is the union of both stores: check the product's own option list if you
need to know what one store sells.
The store CSS matches on Ecwid's generated class name instead, which is the
same value with every space turned into a dash: 'Just Point It - Zia' becomes
'Just-Point-It---Zia'. Filenames here were derived from those class names.
'retired' are designs that still have artwork but are not purchasable on any
product in either store today. Their keys are reconstructed from the old CSS
class names, because the option values no longer exist to check against.
